Cover each scene. The script is what happens; you decide the camera setups in this director's style, and place every spoken line in the shot it is spoken in. Copy sceneNumber from the "## Scene N" headings.

<DIRECTOR_STYLE>
Mood: Authentic and immediate
Camera: Handheld camera with observational framing
References: vertiginous big-wall climbing documentary; unflinching observational documentary portraiture; tense vérité whistleblower documentary
</DIRECTOR_STYLE>

<CHARACTERS>
- MARA
- CYCLIST
</CHARACTERS>

<SCENES>
## Scene 1 — BAKERY KITCHEN
INT. BAKERY KITCHEN - EARLY MORNING
shots: up to 10

INT. BAKERY KITCHEN - EARLY MORNING

MARA, a baker in a flour-dusted apron, kneads dough on a steel bench. She glances at the wall clock.

MARA
We open in five minutes.

---

## Scene 2 — BAKERY STREET
EXT. BAKERY STREET - MORNING
shots: up to 10

EXT. BAKERY STREET - MORNING

MARA flips the shop sign to OPEN and steps out into the morning light. A delivery cyclist waves from across the road.

CYCLIST
Smells amazing today!
</SCENES>

Respond with ONLY valid JSON matching the schema.
